premises.text: Small and retail businesses face a high rate of robberies, many of which go unsolved
premises.evidence_span: In the U.S. last year alone, there were over 75,000 small and retail business robberies. That's over 200 a day, and over 70% of those go unsolved.

premises.text: Traditional surveillance systems are passive and do not provide real-time assistance during crimes
premises.evidence_span: The store did have a dozen high-definition surveillance cameras, but these are passive devices, meaning they don't actually help you in the moment.

premises.text: Remote monitoring services are too expensive for most small businesses
premises.evidence_span: while you can hire monitoring services to have people watch your store remotely, they're too expensive to be practical for most businesses.

premises.text: Deep Science AI can provide real-time threat detection using AI and human analysts
premises.evidence_span: We've built a human-in-the-loop AI surveillance platform that can visually detect weapons, people wearing masks, and intruders after hours.

premises.text: The platform can alert human analysts within fractions of a second when a threat is detected
premises.evidence_span: when a threatening situation develops, our analyst is alerted by our AI within fractions of a second.

premises.text: The platform can contact police immediately when a crime is happening
premises.evidence_span: If a crime is being committed, the police are contacted immediately as the crime is happening, not after.

premises.text: The platform can monitor significantly more camera feeds than traditional methods
premises.evidence_span: human analysts can effectively monitor 15 to 20 camera streams at once. And our platform leverages deep learning to allow the same analysts to now monitor 500 or more feeds.

premises.text: There is a significant market opportunity for remote video monitoring in small and retail businesses
premises.evidence_span: we believe that there are currently 750,000 small and retail business locations in the U.S. alone. We believe that's a billion-dollar market for remote video monitoring.
